request.prompt: A flat, square editorial poster for a fictional Japanese reading club. Fully opaque cream paper background with a faint paper grain, deep forest green as the main ink colour, and one small ochre accent: a thin bookmark ribbon. A single large central motif: an open book whose pages curve upward into one broad leaf, drawn as clean flat shapes in forest green. Generous whitespace around the motif and calm margins on every side. At the top, a large, clear, highly readable Japanese headline in a refined Mincho-style serif reading "こもれび読書会". Below the motif, in smaller clean type, the date and time "2026.11.08 SUN 14:00–16:00" and the venue "小箱図書室". Near the bottom edge, a small quiet qualifier reading "架空のイベント". Render each of these four strings exactly once and add no other text: no address, no link, no QR code, no price, no sponsor, no logo, no extra captions or claims. Balanced grid, crisp edges, print-ready flat graphic design.

alpha.method: Independent operator Pillow decode/count of original bytes; no resave, alpha correction or image editing. Requested opaque cream background is not fully opaque in actual PNG.

literal_review.method: Operator visual reading of original1024PNG and enlarged QA-only crops. No OCR model or human approval. Raster glyph appearance cannot establish Unicode codepoints. No re-generation, retouch or masking.

rows.observed: こもれび読書会と読める。漢字字形の完全一致や組版品質の保証ではない。
2026.11.08 SUN 14:00–16:00と読める。空白と時刻の区切り線の字形は原稿と同じ文字コードと断定できない。
会場の「図」が「圖」のような囲みの多い字形に見える。原稿との字形一致を確認できない。
架空のイベントと読める。原稿との読合せはエージェントによる観察。

literal_review.use_decision: 架空素材の実生成例として原本を保全。実イベントへの転用や印刷前には文字・日付・会場と透過を人が確認する。原稿一致済み/印刷品質保証とはしない。

excerpts.text:
The series includes two 6B-parameter models:

- [Ming-Image-0.1-Design](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ming-Image-0.1-Design)
  generates complete visual designs for UI, infographics, posters, and
  text-rich compositions.
- [Ming-Image-0.1-Design-Layer](https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/Ming-Image-0.1-Design-Layer)
  decomposes flattened design images into independently editable transparent
  layers.

flow.author: 原典と架空の依頼→同じ作者AI1体がprompt/clientを執筆→制作担当が別に匿名Spaceへ1回送る
flow.model: prompt+256query→thinker→queryはconnectorへ/原文はdirect投影へ→両条件がseednoiseのflowtransformerへ→12反復/CFG1→4chVAE→実PNG
flow.use: 原稿と字形/日付/会場・αを別工程で確認→元PNGを保存/用途へ。ブラウザー内生成なし。
